name: Botykapeterd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Botykapeterd: a red shield with a white church and a yellow bunch of grapes, with yellow mantling and a light blue scroll inscribed BOTYKAPETERD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Botykapeterd arms with mantling and scroll
